subject: Food Science
title: Carbohydrates
description: A quick, practical guide to Carbohydrates.

hook.text: Your brain burns 120 grams of glucose per day—about 20% of your total energy. Without carbs, your brain struggles to function.

buildup.text: Carbs are sugar chains. Simple carbs are short (glucose, fructose). Complex carbs are long chains (starch, fiber).

discovery.text: Complex carbs release glucose slowly—sustained energy. Simple carbs spike blood sugar fast—quick energy, then a crash.

twist.text: Fiber is a carb your body can't digest. But gut bacteria ferment it into short-chain fatty acids that feed colon cells.

climax.text: Low-carb diets work for weight loss—not because carbs are bad, but because they cut total calories. The deficit drives results.

punchline.text: Carbs fuel your brain. Quality and quantity matter more than elimination.
